nodes.name: Mark start
nodes.notes: Remembers when this run began and what started it (for the run duration and trigger).

nodes.name: Split claimed
nodes.notes: One item per claimed notification, or a single idle marker when nothing is queued.

parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map((i) => { if (!i.json.message_id) throw new Error('Telegram did not confirm the message (is the bot connected?)'); return i; });

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'run.finished', workflow_key: 'notification-dispatcher', n8n_execution_id: String($execution.id), n8n_workflow_id: $workflow.id, workflow_name: $workflow.name, trigger: $('Mark start').first().json._trigger, status: $json.status, result: { sent: $json.sent, failed: $json.failed, errors: $json.errors }, error: $json.failed ? $json.errors.join('; ') : null, duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - $('Mark start').first().json._t0) }) }}
